title: Large Item Freight Delivery Service-Failure Refund (Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders)
content:
**Care desk reference - Tailwise Online and In-Store Orders, Large Item Freight Delivery.**

A Large Item Freight Delivery order that is not yet completed and carries at least one missed paid appointment receives a service-failure refund against its freight fee. A paid appointment is a redelivery fee charged on the order. An order of another method, a completed order and an order with no missed paid appointment receive no service-failure refund.

## Business effect

The service-failure refund is booked against the freight fee charge - the entry on the order history that charged the fee of kind freight - and goes to the original payment. Once booked, the order history shows a fee refund of kind freight referring to that charge, and the net amount billed on the order falls by the amount refunded. The customer sees the refund on the order history and on the card used for the order.

| Order | Service-failure refund |
|---|---|
| Large Item Freight Delivery, not completed, at least one missed paid appointment | Received, against the freight fee |
| Large Item Freight Delivery, completed | None |
| Large Item Freight Delivery, no missed paid appointment | None |
| Any other fulfillment method | None |

## System tool: `refund_freight_service_failure_8da9af3d`

**Capability.** Books one service-failure refund against the freight delivery fee of a Large Item Freight Delivery order. One call adds one fee refund of kind freight to the order's history, referring to the freight fee charge, sends that amount back to the original payment and lowers the net amount billed on the order by the same amount.

**How it is invoked.** This is an agent-side tool. The agent unlocks it with `unlock_agent_discoverable_tool` and then calls it with `call_agent_discoverable_tool`.

**Parameters.**

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `order_id` | The order number of the freight order, as returned by the order lookup | Id |
| `original_event_id` | The reference number of the order history entry that charged the freight fee on this order (fee kind freight), as returned by the order history lookup | Id |
| `amount_usd` | The refund amount in USD; it is booked exactly as given | A positive number with 2 decimal places, already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** A receipt with `refund_id` (the reference number of the new fee refund entry), `order_id`, `original_event_id` (the freight fee charge refunded), `fee_kind` (always freight), `amount_usd` (the amount refunded, USD with 2 decimal places), `refund_method` (always `original_payment`), `event_date` (the booking date, YYYY-MM-DD) and `billed_total_usd` (the net amount billed on the order with this refund taken off). A returned `refund_id` means the refund is booked.
